Name: threshold
Description: Classification score lesser than this threshold would be rejected

Name: custom_parse_classifier_func
Description:
Name of the custom classifier output parsing function.
If not specified, Gst-nvinfer uses the internal parsing function with NCHW tensor order for softmax layers. User can reshape other output tensor order to NCHW in Triton config.pbtxt to run internal parsing.
If specified, also need to set custom_lib to load custom library.
